brief:
The UN human rights chief warned Wednesday of a "real threat" to Palestinian existence in Gaza, citing a growing risk of further atrocity crimes, Middle East Eye reported. Volker Turk called on all states to take action to prevent escalating violations against Palestinians in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

The warning reflects heightened international concern over the humanitarian situation and security conditions facing Palestinians in the territory.

title: UN rights chief warns of existential threat to Palestinians in Gaza
